Spread Collar Elegance

Breathable Comfort 
Experience the ultimate comfort with IndoPrimo’s solid satin shirt. Designed for breathability, this shirt allows for excellent air circulation, keeping you cool and comfortable throughout the day. It’s perfect for those long workdays or casual outings, ensuring you feel fresh at all times. 
Resilient Quality 
Crafted with high-quality satin, this shirt is built to last. The resilient fabric maintains its shape and appearance even after multiple washes. It withstands daily wear and tear, making it a durable addition to your wardrobe that retains its pristine look over time. 
Soft Touch

Sweat Absorption
